# Preserve this 🧭 comment and its original punctuation.
! A comment ending in an odd slash is still not continued. \
escaped\ key\:\= : first harbor
unicode\u002Ekey = Ready %1$s
continued.value = north \
    west pier
whitespace.key       before
key.only
empty.colon :
line.break = North%nSouth
literal.percent = 40%% ready
key.contin\
   ued = joined key
visible key = nonbreaking key
